Global Outlook
Global economic conditions remain uncertain.
On the eve of US tariff deadline, many countries have yet to finalise trade deals.
The risk of permanently higher tariffs or adverse geopolitical developments persists, weighing on the global outlook.
Inflation Outlook
While the rand has strengthened, food prices have come under pressure and fuel prices are declining more slowly.
Inflation is expected to average 3.3% for the year before stabilising at the 3% target by 2027.
Economic Outlook
With economic activity weak and with possible higher US tariffs on South Africa, growth is revised down from 1.2% to 1%.
Interest Rate Projection
